hook: 5 things you missed in crypto today

stories.text: EU targets DeFi and staking beyond MiCA rulebook
stories.summary: European Parliament asks the European Commission to assess regulatory gaps in DeFi lending, staking, and NFTs beyond MiCA's scope.

stories.text: SEC proposes crypto safe harbor rules this month
stories.summary: SEC updates its 2026 agenda to propose a crypto safe harbor rule for startups and DeFi, opening public comment soon.

stories.text: Tether burns $3B USDT on Ethereum, largest since February
stories.summary: Tether burns $2.5 billion USDT on Ethereum, its biggest burn since February 2026, reducing supply on the network.

stories.text: France enforces new MiCA rules for crypto firms
stories.summary: France implements stricter EU crypto rules under MiCA, raising investor protection and operational standards for firms.

stories.text: Crypto kiosks scammed $56M from Texans last year
stories.summary: Crypto ATMs were used to scam $56 million from Texans in 2025, prompting lawmakers to push for regulation.
